0:/system/main.ks

inits GLOBAL flightData LEXICON
loads utils + audio

destruct alt, clamp TWR, ...

Mission sequence

launchShipClampTWR()
trackFlightStats()
monitorEngines()
armDownrangeGuidance()
armAltitudeDetonation()
WAIT UNTIL FALSE
